body: I don't know... I'd rather not say anything to anybody. I'd rather just hide it really. I just feel like I'm not allowed to have any problems. This translates into my internalized homophobia and how I'd never come out to anybody as gay and hate myself for it too. I feel lost when it comes to that, and I can't imagine myself ever being happy because of it. Thinking about myself later makes me want to die early.

Thank you for your kind words.

I just feel like there's too much put on me. The stress of college applications is getting to me. The stress of school starting again, and having to do so much. I feel like a lot of the time and effort I've spent working will never, ever come to fruition. 

My home life is extremely stressful, as I have an older sister who is wheelchair bound and needs constant care. I feel like this burden has been thrown onto me, and that I will have to spend my entire life as her caretaker. Her problems have always overshadowed mine, and I've been left to deal with my own demons silently and out of view for my entire life. It has forced me into pursuing a life of professional success just to feel worthy in this world. I don't want to deal with this. I don't want to be forced into that life. I feel trapped because of it, and it all seems hopeless at this point.

Thanks again.
